anchors.identity: One dark segmented sky-repair worker keeps the accepted silhouette and long red cape.
anchors.wardrobe_props: The amber repair light remains in the raised outstretched hand and the thin safety cable remains attached at the lower torso.
anchors.space_direction: The steel tower stays left, the worker starts screen-right, and the exterior camera side remains stable.
anchors.light_material: Cold storm light, warm fissure edges, dull wet steel, and weighted red cloth retain their accepted response.

protected.state: The same dark worker, attached red cape, amber hand light, and torso cable remain visible.
The tower stays left, storm sky stays right, and the exterior camera remains stable.
Wet steel, weighted red cloth, cold storm light, and amber edge light remain stable.

transitions.subject: the cable-suspended worker
transitions.from_state: the body hangs almost horizontal screen-right of the tower on a taut lower cable
transitions.transition: taut cable tension curves the body back until both boots plant on the outer rib
transitions.to_state: both boots hold on the tower with the cable taut
transitions.proof: both boots remain visibly planted on the outer rib

transitions.subject: the amber hand light and vertical fissure
transitions.from_state: the bright vertical fissure remains open beside the recovered worker
transitions.transition: the hand light touches the seam and amber closure travels upward
transitions.to_state: one repaired steel edge replaces the opening
transitions.proof: one uninterrupted repaired edge remains beside the planted worker

checkpoints.state: The opening matches the horizontal worker screen-right of the tower, taut cable, red cape, amber hand light, and open fissure.
checkpoints.visual_test: Worker silhouette, cape, light hand, cable direction, tower side, fissure, and storm light match the accepted endpoint.

checkpoints.state: The accepted screen-right motion slows as cable tension curves the worker back toward the tower.
checkpoints.visual_test: Body inertia, cable tension, cape drag, and the return arc form one continuous motion.

checkpoints.state: Both boots plant on the outer rib while the taut cable and attached cape settle.
checkpoints.visual_test: Two boot contacts, stable tower geography, taut cable, and the same worker remain visible.

checkpoints.state: The amber hand light touches the fissure and closure travels upward until one repaired steel edge remains.
checkpoints.visual_test: One hand-light contact begins a visible closure that removes the open seam.

checkpoints.state: The worker holds both boots beside the sealed seam with the cable taut and cape attached.
checkpoints.visual_test: The final frame proves boot contact, stable identity and props, taut cable, tower geography, and a sealed seam.
